key_findings: Graduate Studies Application is an application page, not a programme record.
Official TUM Asia wording says master applicants need not submit GRE or GATE; these tests should not be extracted as requirements.
Central current graduate requirements state related bachelor's degree, English proof unless waived, and APS for China, India, or Vietnam degree holders.
Rail and Urban Transport has current readable programme facts: M.Sc., 120 ECTS, August 2026 intake, and 1 Oct 2025 to 31 Mar 2026 application period.
Integrated Circuit Design and Green Electronics current seed pages were not text-readable here, so programme-specific close dates and fees require manual confirmation.
v0.2 recovers crawler-only TUM Asia graduate programs Aerospace Engineering and Industrial Chemistry as genuine v0.1 omissions, with JavaScript-gated pages marked for human review.
v0.2 corrects Rail and Urban Transport to the extended 10 Jun 2026 application period and adds crawler-captured application dates/fees for the seeded TUM programs.
The crawler Industrial Chemistry case-study extraction was treated as curriculum text, not an admissions test requirement.
known_gaps: Current HTML for Green Electronics and Integrated Circuit Design returned a JavaScript-required page in the available official-site reader; official older PDFs were used only for programme identity and academic background.
Programme-specific language thresholds may differ from the central current graduate requirement and should be manually verified before publication.
Aerospace Engineering and Industrial Chemistry individual pages were JavaScript-gated in live reading, so v0.2 uses crawler evidence plus official navigation and flags both for human review.
TUM Asia has additional graduate programs in the live navigation, but v0.2 intentionally repairs only confirmed crawler-vs-v0.1 gaps for the selected audit scope.
